Elaine (Sales): Quick heads up — Prospect CustodialAI is asking for a dedicated POC and pushing for a 35% pilot discount to match a competitor. They also want SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence. Need deal-desk/discount approval to close this week.
Omar (Solutions Eng): Re: dedicated POC — we can spin a 2xA100 dedicated pool with VPC isolation. No code changes required. Recommend a 3mo paid pilot with auto-fallback to hosted variants.
Margot (Deal Desk): What are their expected spend and token volume for the POC? 35% is outside standard. We typically authorize up to 20% for pilots; anything >30% needs VP sign-off.
Elaine (Sales): Estimated usage: ~120M tokens over 3 months, list price ~ $26,000. Customer is willing to sign a paid pilot if we provide 30% and a conversion credit. Proposed quote snippet: ```Line item: Redwood Dedicated (2xA100) / 3mo = $26,000 list
Proposed concession: 30% => $18,200 net
Conversion credit: pilot spend applied to first 6mo invoice if converted within 90 days```
Raj (Finance): Ping — margin check: at 30% concession net rev ~$18.2k; with infra discounts our gross margin estimate ~38%. Need infra ops confirmation on reserved GPU cost. Any approval conditional on maintaining at least 30% gross margin.
Margot (Deal Desk): I can provisionally approve up to 25% now. For 30% we need Leon sign-off + legal sign-off on conversion language. Also require security acknowledgement re: SOC2 + data residency. My suggested conditions: 1) 3mo paid pilot, 2) conversion credit only if conversion signed within window, 3) standard support level only (no premium SLA included).
Leon (VP Sales): I can sign off on 30% concession provided we get either a 6-month MRR commitment on conversion OR a conversion guarantee: if customer doesn't convert within 90 days, concession is retroactively billed back. Legal must approve wording. Finance must confirm margin floor.
Elaine (Sales): Quick clarifying q — customer prefers a 90-day conversion window (not 120). Is that acceptable?
Leon (VP Sales): 90 days is acceptable. Approving 30% conditional on Legal, Finance, and Security confirmations.
Margot (Deal Desk): I'll open an approval ticket and loop Legal (@legal-team). Drafting the concession appendix now; will include the retro-bill clause and conversion credit terms.
security-bot: SSQ received (2026-03-20 09:12 UTC) — requests: SOC2 Type II report, ISO27001 cert, KMS key handling docs. Please attach artifacts or provide CertOps contact.
Omar (Solutions Eng): I'll pull SOC2 artifacts and prepare a VPC/KMS diagram. ETA: EOD tomorrow.
Elaine (Sales): Thanks everyone — I'll share the draft concession with the customer once Margot posts it and start the SSQ handoff. :tada: 
Margot (Deal Desk): Noted — once Legal drafts the clause I’ll route it to Leon for final sign-off and then prepare a one-page internal approval memo for Finance records.
Raj (Finance): Please cc me on the approval memo. I’ll run a final margin sanity check after infra ops numbers come in.
Elaine (Sales): On it. Will also ask CustodialAI to return the signed pilot within 48hrs of receiving the draft to hit the 90-day conversion window.
Omar (Solutions Eng): FYI I'll also enable prefix caching and a conservative batching config to keep token cost predictable during the POC.
Elaine (Sales): Appreciate it. Will update the thread with the signed pilot or any blocker. :+1:
